editorial:
Picture this: you're Laurent, and you've just been told you need a colonoscopy. Your doctor keeps trying to calm you down, but every word he says makes you more nervous. That's the heart of this quirky comedy. The whole movie plays like one long, awkward doctor's visit, turning a routine medical procedure into a funny and surprisingly relatable story. The humor comes from the little moments, like Laurent's growing panic and the doctor's clumsy attempts to be reassuring. It's the kind of movie that makes you laugh at something you'd normally dread, and you'll find yourself rooting for Laurent the whole way through.

The acting is solid, especially Laurent's nervous energy, which carries the whole film. The pacing moves quickly, so you never feel bored, and the jokes land more often than not. On the downside, some scenes feel a bit stretched, and the humor can get repetitive if you're not into medical comedy. Still, if you enjoy awkward, character-driven laughs, this one is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Laurent finally goes through with the colonoscopy. The doctor, who has been nervous the whole time, admits he was more scared than Laurent. The camera reveals nothing serious, just a clean bill of health. The twist is that Laurent's anxiety was the real problem all along, and the doctor's awkward reassurance was his own way of coping. They both laugh it off, and Laurent leaves relieved, promising never to put off a checkup again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves awkward comedies and lighthearted medical humor.
